'''Anatoly Ivanovich Kholkin''' ({{langx|ru|Анатолий Иванович Холькин}}; 8 March 1937 – 31 August 2026) was a Russian chemist. A member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]], he was a recipient of the [[Order of Honour (Russia)|Order of Honour of Russia]] (1997).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ras.ru/news/shownews.aspx?id=1eac4a73-a526-4bb9-8f74-ab3dd673a05e|title=Академику Холькину Анатолию Ивановичу - 75 лет!|work=Росси́йская акаде́мия нау́к|date=8 March 2012|access-date=5 September 2026|language=Russian}}</ref>

Kholkin died on 31 August 2026, at the age of 89.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://new.ras.ru/academy-new/staff/akademiki/kholkin-anatoliy-ivanovich/|title=Хо́лькин Анато́лий Ива́нович|work=Росси́йская акаде́мия нау́к|access-date=5 September 2026|language=Russian}}</ref>
